nodes.trans: Hello, welcome. Are you checking in?

replies.trans: No. Do you have a room available tonight?

nodes.trans: Sure, what name is the reservation under?

nodes.text: 잠시만요, 확인해 볼게요. 오늘은 더블룸이 하나 남아 있는데, 괜찮으세요?
nodes.pron: jamsimanyo, hwaginhae bolgeyo. oneureun deobeullumi hana nama inneunde, gwaenchaneuseyo?
nodes.trans: One moment, let me check. We have one double room left today. Would that be okay?

replies.text: 음, 다른 데 좀 알아볼게요. 감사합니다.
replies.pron: eum, dareun de jom arabolgeyo. gamsahamnida.
replies.trans: Hmm, I'll look somewhere else. Thank you.

nodes.text: 네, 조식 포함이고요. 아침 일곱 시부터 열 시까지 드실 수 있어요.
nodes.pron: ne, josik pohamigoyo. achim ilgop sibuteo yeol sikkaji deusil su isseoyo.
nodes.trans: Yes, breakfast is included. You can have it from seven to ten in the morning.
Thank you. Could you show me your passport?

nodes.text: 시내가 보이는 방이 좋으세요, 아니면 정원 쪽 조용한 방이 좋으세요?
nodes.pron: sinaega boineun bangi joeuseyo, animyeon jeongwon jjok joyonghan bangi joeuseyo?
nodes.trans: Would you like a room with a city view, or a quiet room facing the garden?

replies.trans: A room with a city view, please.

nodes.text: 여기 카드 키예요. 방은 팔 층이에요.
nodes.pron: yeogi kadeu kiyeyo. bangeun pal cheungieyo.
nodes.trans: Here's your key card. Your room is on the eighth floor.

replies.trans: Is there Wi-Fi in the room?

nodes.trans: Checkout is at eleven in the morning.

replies.trans: Can I leave my bags after checkout?

nodes.trans: Of course. We'll keep your bags at the front desk.

nodes.text: 엘리베이터는 저 모퉁이 돌아서 바로 오른쪽에 있어요.
nodes.pron: elribeiteoneun jeo motungi doraseo baro oreunjjoge isseoyo.
nodes.trans: The elevator is just around that corner, on the right.

nodes.text: 네, 무료로 쓰실 수 있어요. 비밀번호는 카드 키 뒷면에 있어요.
nodes.pron: ne, muryoro sseusil su isseoyo. bimilbeonhoneun kadeu ki dwinmyeone isseoyo.
nodes.trans: Yes, it's free to use. The password is on the back of your key card.
Is there anything else you need?

replies.trans: Is there a good restaurant nearby?

nodes.text: 두 블록만 가시면 현지인들이 자주 가는 식당이 있어요. 지도에 표시해 드릴게요.
nodes.pron: du beullongman gasimyeon hyeonjiindeuri jaju ganeun sikdangi isseoyo. jidoe pyosihae deurilgeyo.
nodes.trans: Just two blocks away there's a restaurant locals love. I'll mark it on the map for you.
You're welcome. Have a comfortable stay!

nodes.text: 네, 알겠습니다. 조심히 가시고 즐거운 여행 되세요!
nodes.pron: ne, algetseumnida. josimhi gasigo jeulgeoun yeohaeng doeseyo!
nodes.trans: Okay, I understand. Take care and have a great trip!
